{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c_resource} seconds

(PH) Passive:
While equipped on the knight, {c_important}Battle Standard{/c} grants you and allies around you {c_number}[{SF_2} * 100|%|]{/c} life regen per second.

(PH) Active:
The knight throws the {c_important}Battle Standard{/c} and creates an area that pulses holy flames that deal {c_number}{payload:ENEMIES_DAMAGE_PAYLOAD}{/c} damage to enemies and heals your allies for {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|%|]{/c} each pulse
